title: WorkflowDefinitionV1
description: Workflow definition plane artifact: a durable, versioned workflow definition stored in the kernel and executed by the workflow sink on the synthetic `workflow.kernel` channel. JSON is canonical; YAML is a serialization view only. Field-level semantics are the interpreter contract: the palette is closed, `decide` always carries a `fallback`, and every `invoke` carries a mandatory `timeout`.

id.description: Definition identity (stable across versions); the store keys on (id, version).

version.description: Monotonic version; a PUT of an existing id stores a new row, instances pin the version they started on.

enabled.description: Enable-time gate. Disabled definitions never contribute trigger subscriptions; enabling a definition whose palette contains a not-yet-executable step kind is refused (validator `step-kind-not-supported`).

steps.description: Flat step list; execution order comes from the `on:` edge selectors, the array order breaks ties deterministically.

team.description: Optional team scope (slug): the definition only fires for work/events in that team.

output.description: What a completed instance publishes to a waiting parent.

composition.description: Sub-workflow budgets for this definition as a callee.

duration.description: ISO-8601 duration restricted to day/hour/minute/second (e.g. "PT15M", "P1D"); the validator rejects a zero total.

ref.description: Value reference: a literal string, or a template over run context ("$event.data.<path>", "$steps.<stepId>.output.<jsonPath>", "$work.<field>", "$input.<name>", "$child.status").

matcher.description: Event-payload matcher value, copied from the policy-file matcher law: exact string, bare "*", or a single trailing "*" prefix-glob; scalars match by equality.

jsonPath.description: Projection path over a JSON document: dotted segments with optional [$n] / [*] indices, resolved by System.Text.Json only (no expression language).

event.description: Wire event type this definition triggers on; the validator requires the mirrored schema id to exist.

where.description: Map of dotted `data.*` paths to matcher values; all must match (AND). Only meaningful with `event`.

schedule.description: Cadence spec, verbatim law of the schedule plane (`interval:<n>m` | `daily:HH:mm` | `cron:<5 fields>`), evaluated by the shared schedule-spec parser.

invoked.description: Callable-only marker: startable exclusively by a parent's `invoke` step, never by events or a schedule.

edge.description: Outgoing edge selector: `always`, `timeout`, `failed`, or `<stepId>:completed`. Default (absent) is `always`. At most one outgoing edge per branch key.

id.description: Step identity, unique within the document; step-log rows and edges reference it.

title.description: Operator-facing step label (the console checklist line).

on.description: Edge this step is reached by. The entry step(s) use `always` or omit `on`.

command.description: Wire command appended verbatim as the effect; the validator requires membership in the fail-closed command table.

capability.description: Capability id: dispatch appends a routing intent (the routing funnel chooses the endpoint).

inputs.description: Envelope inputs: values are literals or `#/$defs/ref` templates.

to.description: Envelope target reference; resolved from run context (defaults to the trigger's own target).

emit.description: Append one effect: a named wire command, or a capability routed through the funnel.

event.description: Event type awaited; the definition joins the subscription set while the instance is parked.

correlate.description: Correlation key resolved at park time (e.g. "$steps.assign.output.workId"); matched against the waking envelope.

onTimeout.description: Step id taken when the deadline passes (the sweeper drives it).

wait.description: Park the instance (`waiting`) until a matching event wakes it or the timeout edge fires.

timer.description: Park until the delay elapses; the sweeper is the clock.

approvers.description: Approver actor refs (comma-separated D4 actors or a ref resolving to them).

approval.description: Raise a human decision through the existing approval ledger, park, resume on `approval.decided` correlated by approval id.

source.description: `model` consults the decision gateway with a closed option list (degrade to `fallback` on low confidence or AI outage); `guard` is a deterministic field predicate with no model and no telemetry.

value.description: Closed answer the model may choose.

branch.description: Step id, or the literal "end": completes the instance right there.

question.description: Model question + closed option set; required when source is `model`.

field.description: Field path in the built-in context (`work.state`, `event.data.action`, ...).

equals.description: Exact scalar match; null matches a field that resolves to absent/null (presence branching).

guard.description: Deterministic predicate; required when source is `guard`.

fallback.description: Always required: branch taken when the answer is unresolvable or its branch is unknown. A step id, or the literal "end".

decide.description: Branch on a model answer or a deterministic guard predicate. Every branch target is a step id or "end".

project.description: Output name -> jsonPath over earlier step outputs / the trigger envelope. Missing paths yield null (never an error).

select.description: Pure projection: copy fields out of earlier outputs.

over.description: Reference to the array to iterate.

step.description: Inline emit payload executed once per element.

fan-out.description: Declared in v1, executed when the fan-out consumer lands (enable-time `step-kind-not-supported` until then).

expect.description: Number of awaited child effects before advancing.

join.description: Declared in v1, executed with fan-out.

noteRef.description: Note for the successor work's objective (first line wins), matching the review-arm law.

fork-work.description: Port of the fork law: successor Work + `created`/`work.linked` rows + binding repoint + reply, with a deterministic successor work id.

objectiveRef.description: Objective text for the created work.

capability.description: Capability of the routing intent appended for the new work (there is no `command.work.create` wire command: this maps onto the shared CreateWork + AppendRoutingIntent law).

team.description: Owning team slug; defaults to the instance's team.

work-create.description: Create a Work and append its routing intent; the created work carries this instance in `works.workflow_instance_id`.

escalate.description: Write a notification-ledger row for a human.

memory.description: Declared in v1, executed when the memory step consumer lands.

workflow.description: Callable definition id (must exist, be enabled, and keep the invoke-call graph acyclic).

version.description: Pinned callee version; absent = the callee's live enabled version, pinned into the child at creation.

inputs.description: Child inputs; stored as the child's initial step-log row.

await.description: True: the parent parks and resumes with the child's projected output. False: fire-and-forget (the child is cascade-cancelled only if the parent fails or is cancelled).

timeout.description: Mandatory: breach cancels the non-terminal descendant subtree and takes `onTimeout`.

onTimeout.description: Step id taken on timeout; absent means the `failed` edge.

invoke.description: Sub-workflow call: starts a child instance in the parent's transaction, optionally awaits its output.

project.description: Select-law projection over the instance step log: what a completed instance publishes to a caller. Absent block publishes {}.

reentrant.description: Whether this definition may appear more than once in one ancestor chain.

maxInvocations.description: Per-definition occurrence cap along a single ancestor chain.
